candidates.name: Papillary thyroid carcinoma
support_spans: a large, firm, mildly tender mass on the right side of the neck
Fine-needle aspiration biopsy of the right lobe yielded a hemorrhagic background with isolated clusters of pleomorphic round and oval nuclei
candidates.why: The patient presents with a large neck mass and suspicious fine-needle aspiration biopsy results, which are consistent with thyroid cancer.

candidates.name: Anaplastic thyroid cancer
support_spans: a large, firm, mildly tender mass on the right side of the neck
the entire right lobe was replaced by a hypo- to anechoic mass measuring approximately 6 × 4 × 6 cm
candidates.why: The patient's large and rapidly growing neck mass is concerning for an aggressive thyroid cancer.

candidates.name: Medullary thyroid carcinoma
support_spans: elevated anti-thyroglobulin antibody
elevated anti-thyroid peroxidase antibody
candidates.why: The patient's elevated thyroid antibodies may indicate an autoimmune component to their thyroid disease.

candidates.name: Follicular thyroid carcinoma
support_spans: Fine-needle aspiration biopsy of the right lobe yielded a hemorrhagic background with isolated clusters of pleomorphic round and oval nuclei
candidates.why: The patient's fine-needle aspiration biopsy results are suspicious for a primary thyroid malignancy.

candidates.name: Metastatic thyroid cancer
support_spans: Contrast-enhanced CT of the neck and thorax confirmed a voluminous right thyroid mass and detected two pulmonary nodules consistent with metastases
candidates.why: The patient's CT scan shows pulmonary nodules consistent with metastases, which would confirm a diagnosis of metastatic thyroid cancer.
